artifacts.description: The primary CLI + daemon single-binary bundle. If this is missing, the release is not installable at all.
Short-name alias binary shipped alongside port-daddy.

Out-of-process daemon supervisor (ADR-0036). A release that ships without this installs with no watchdog and a dead daemon never restarts -- the exact regression a manifest-driven verify step exists to prevent (previously caught only by a single hand-added `test -s dist/pd-bosun` line in release.yml after it shipped broken once).
The install entrypoint most users run via curl | bash.
Windows build. Optional -- this release lane only runs on macOS/Linux runners, so absence is expected and must SKIP, not FAIL.
